theorems.name: Submission.dorag_sn_hausdorff_le_mul_of_lower_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ (ν : Measure (Euclid N)) (A O : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen O → A ⊆ O → (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < t₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (c * t ^ n) ≤ ν (closedBall x t)) → μHE[n] A ≤ C * ν O
